rules.no_new_closing_low: minimum close not in final 3 base sessions
rules.higher_low: min low of last 3 base sessions > min low of earlier base
rules.volume: avg volume final 3 base sessions >= 1.5x median base volume
rules.breakout: breakout-day close > highest high of prior base
rules.outcome: target before -4% stop within next 10 sessions; same-bar target+stop counted as stop first
